title: Sharp lifespan results for plane-symmetric fluids on decelerated spacetimes
summary: In this article, we analyze plane-symmetric solutions to the relativistic Euler equations on spatially flat spacetimes with decelerated expansion. We consider a linear equation of state $p(ρ)=Kρ$ and power law inflation $a(t)=t^α$, where $0<K<\frac{1}{3}$ and $0\leqα<1$. Previous results imply nonlinear stability of the homogeneous and isotropic solution above an expansion threshold $α_\text{crit}=\frac{2}{3(1-K)}$.
